assertionCountExplanation: The original field.waitForExistence(timeout:5) XCTAssertTrue is replaced with guard field.waitForExistence(timeout:5), then XCTFail and return false. The failure gate remains. All17 method bodies are byte-identical, including every method-body assertion/postcondition.
rationale: NativeScrollPalette is applied to NativeList and NativeForm. Its old light branch inherited native foreground hierarchy; d24b explicitly applies Color.primary/secondary while setting .bar as the light toolbar material. Using hierarchical light styles retains hierarchy/material-vibrancy semantics within the stable modifier chain. The dark colors remain the same; type erasure gives the light and dark ternary values the same ShapeStyle type.

primaryReferences.support: Apple distinguishes custom foreground styles from hierarchical styles for material vibrancy.
Primary and secondary map to levels of the current content style.

limitations: No visible light-mode regression has been established from a render.
The proposed patch was generated from committed bytes only; no owner file was edited or committed.
No compilation, simulator boot, native UI execution, CI dispatch, push or deployment was performed.
